sources.publisher: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
sources.title: Corporate Applications Search — Ripple National Trust Bank
claims: OCC control number 2025-Charter-342347; proposed bank name Ripple National Trust Bank; proposed charter 25364.
Filing status lists receipt 2025-07-02, Approved 2025-12-12 and Consummated/Effective 2026-10-26.
limitations: The CAS record establishes the effective/consummated filing status; it does not establish that the bank has opened or begun providing services to clients.
No separate final approval letter was retrieved in this run.

sources.title: Ripple Receives Final OCC Approval to Establish National Trust Bank
claims: Ripple says OCC granted final approval for Ripple National Trust Bank on 2026-10-26.
Ripple says the bank's approved activities include managing segregated RLUSD reserves, acting as collateral trustee for RLUSD holders and providing fiduciary digital-asset custody upon opening.
Ripple says RLUSD will continue to be issued by Standard Custody & Trust Company, its NYDFS-regulated limited-purpose trust company.
Ripple says BNY is the primary reserve custodian for RLUSD.
limitations: This is Ripple's description of the approved business plan; the CAS record is the regulator-side status evidence.
The release does not establish the date the bank opens or the date any reserve-management/custody service begins.

sources.publisher: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
sources.title: Corporate Applications Search — First National Digital Currency Bank
claims: OCC control number 2025-Charter-342299; proposed bank name First National Digital Currency Bank, N.A.
Filing status lists receipt 2025-06-30, Approved 2025-12-12 and Consummated/Effective 2026-07-24.
limitations: The CAS record establishes effective/consummated status, not the date Circle National Trust began serving clients.

sources.title: Circle Receives Final OCC Approval to Establish National Trust Bank
claims: Circle says First National Digital Currency Bank, N.A. will operate as Circle National Trust under OCC supervision.
Circle says the initial milestone supports federally supervised custody and that management of USDC reserves is planned as a future capability.
limitations: The announcement does not establish that the bank is already managing USDC reserves or has opened all planned services.

sources.title: Ripple Expands Strategic Digital Assets Collaboration with BNY Across Custody and Tokenized Trade Finance
claims: BNY says it now supports XRP and RLUSD on its Digital Asset Custody platform.
BNY identifies itself as primary reserve custodian for RLUSD and says it has a custody relationship with Ripple Prime.
BNY intends to work with Ripple to enable clients to mint and redeem RLUSD directly through BNY, subject to final BNY and regulatory approvals.
BNY and Ripple intend to advance tokenized trade finance on XRPL and are exploring a supply-chain finance initiative with C2FO, subject to client requirements.
limitations: The release publishes no XRP or RLUSD custody balances, client count or transaction volume.
Mint/redeem services and tokenized trade-finance plans are intended future capabilities, not confirmed live services.

sources.title: C2FO and Ripple Partner to Modernize Trade Finance Using the XRP Ledger
claims: C2FO Instant Pay is described as using XRPL and RLUSD for settlement, with participating capital providers funding instant supplier payments against approved invoices.
The release says businesses can join a waitlist for C2FO Instant Pay.
C2FO says its existing Early Pay programs have helped businesses access more than USD 520B in working capital through accelerated payment of approved invoices.
limitations: The USD 520B figure is historical platform-wide working-capital access, not XRPL volume or C2FO Instant Pay volume.
The waitlist and announcement do not establish any completed XRPL invoice-funding transaction, funded amount or RLUSD settlement volume.

sources.title: Aviva Investors launches tokenised share class for USD Liquidity Fund with Ripple
claims: Aviva Investors says it successfully launched a tokenised share class of its USD Liquidity Fund on XRPL.
The tokenised share class was approved by the Central Bank of Ireland.
Komainu provided regulated institutional digital-asset custody; Licuido provided tokenisation infrastructure; BNY remains custodian of the fund's underlying assets.
limitations: The release does not disclose tokenised share-class AUM, XRPL token supply, investor count or secondary-market turnover.
A tokenised fund share is not XRP collateral and does not establish net XRP purchases.

sources.title: EUR CoinVertible is now available on the XRP Ledger
claims: SG-FORGE says EUR CoinVertible launched on XRPL on 2026-02-18.
The launch is supported by Ripple's custody solution.
SG-FORGE says use of EUR CoinVertible in Ripple products and as trading collateral is an opportunity to explore.
limitations: The source does not state that EUR CoinVertible is currently used as collateral or that a live Ripple product integration exists.

sources.title: Ripple Teams up with Mastercard, WebBank, and Gemini to Bring Stablecoin Settlement with RLUSD
claims: Ripple announced an initiative to explore RLUSD on XRPL for stablecoin settlement of Gemini Credit Card fiat transactions involving Mastercard and WebBank.
The release says initial RLUSD onboarding and integration planning were subject to regulatory approvals.
limitations: The announcement is a collaboration and exploration statement, not evidence of completed settlement volume or an operational production integration.
